minimum_effect.rationale: Choose a retrieval-accuracy effect on the recovered original endpoint using task relevance and baseline variability, before candidate evaluation; no new AUC margin is inherited.

paper_win_requires: Recover original Figure 5 invocation, delay grid, all specified dynamical families and decoder/fold semantics; retain complete required curves and failures.
Compare with an authenticated numeric source result and a qualified author rerun under identical simulation/input conditions.
Declare original endpoint, task-specific meaningful effect, uncertainty and complete episode budgets before optimization.

episode.improvement_loop: Source recovery only until admission: expose declared development feedback only after an exact original-task comparator is reconstructed. Prospective simulation and forecast profiles remain separately labelled.

episode.final_evaluation: Use the recovered original simulation protocol and preserved full denominators; no substitute grid, easier noise condition or subset of networks. No evaluation is authorized by this file.
